## Bio

Postdoctoral Fellow in the [CLIMB lab](https://siankou-giesbrecht.weebly.com/group.html) at Simon Fraser University. I completed my PhD in February 2026 at the University of Saskatchewan, focused on advancing models of snow and energy exchange in needleleaf forests in western and northern Canada. My current research investigates how climate change impacts interconnected ecological, hydrological, and biogeochemical systems.

<p></p>
